pages.body:
Why This Book Exists


When you first start following Jesus, you learn about the New Testament. You learn about His birth. You learn about His miracles. You learn about His death. You learn about His resurrection. You learn about His grace. It is exciting. It is new. It is wonderful.


But then you open the Old Testament. You read about Adam and Eve. You read about Noah and the ark. You read about Abraham and Isaac. You read about Joseph and his brothers. You read about Moses and the Red Sea. You read about David and Goliath. You read about Jonah and the big fish. You might wonder, "What do these have to do with Jesus? What do they have to do with my new life?"


Here is the secret. They are shadows. They are not the real thing. They are not the substance. They are shadows. They are previews. They are patterns. They are clues. And every single one of them points to Jesus. They are the Old Testament shadows. He is the New Testament reality.


This book is for you. You are new to the faith. You are building your foundation. Over the next 30 days, we are going to look at 30 Old Testament shadows. We are going to see what they meant. We are going to see how they point to Jesus. And we are going to see how they point to your new life.


The Value You Will Get


By the end of this book, you will not see the Old Testament as just a collection of old stories. You will see it as a gallery of shadows. You will see it as a pattern. You will see it as a blueprint. You will understand the Old Testament shadows. You will understand their meaning. You will understand why they matter today. You will have a new confidence in your faith. You will have a new love for your Bible. And you will have a new appreciation for the one who is the fulfillment of every shadow.

pages.footer: Day 1 of 30 (Free Preview - Days 1 to 3 are Free)
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"The LORD God formed a man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living being." - Genesis 2:7 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Adam was the first man. He was formed from the dust. He was given the breath of life. He was a living being. He was a shadow. He was a preview. He was a pattern. And he points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"So it is written: 'The first man Adam became a living being'; the last Adam, a life-giving spirit." - 1 Corinthians 15:45


Jesus is the last Adam. He is the second Adam. He is the life-giving spirit. Adam was a shadow. Jesus is the reality. Adam brought death. Jesus brought life. Adam brought sin. Jesus brought righteousness. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You have a new life. You might wonder where it came from. It came from Jesus. The first Adam brought death. The last Adam brought life. You have the life-giving spirit. You have new life in Jesus.


Faith Builder
Write down this truth: "I have new life in Jesus." Say it out loud. Thank Jesus for giving you new life.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the last Adam. Thank you for giving me new life. Thank you for the life-giving spirit. Help me to live in your life. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 1: The Shadow of Adam

pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"Then the LORD God made a woman from the rib he had taken out of the man, and he brought her to the man." - Genesis 2:22 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Eve was the first woman. She was made from the rib of Adam. She was brought to the man. She was a shadow. She was a preview. She was a pattern. And she points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"For we are members of his body. 'For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.' This is a profound mystery—but I am talking about Christ and the church." - Ephesians 5:30-32


Jesus is the greater Adam. The church is the greater Eve. The church was made from the side of Jesus. The church was brought to him. The church is his bride. Eve was a shadow. The church is the reality. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You are part of the church. You are part of the body of Christ. You are the bride of Christ. You were made from his side. You were brought to him. You belong to him.


Faith Builder
Think about your church family. Write down one person who makes you feel like you belong. Thank God for them.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for the church. Thank you for making me part of your body. Thank you for making me your bride. Help me to love the church. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 2: The Shadow of Eve

pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"Consecrate to me every firstborn male. The first offspring of every womb among the Israelites belongs to me, whether human or animal." - Exodus 13:2 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The firstborn was special. The firstborn was set apart. The firstborn belonged to God. The firstborn was a shadow. The firstborn was a preview. The firstborn was a pattern. And the firstborn points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"For those God foreknew he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers and sisters." - Romans 8:29


Jesus is the firstborn. He is the firstborn of all creation. He is the firstborn from the dead. He is the firstborn among many brothers and sisters. The firstborn in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might feel like an outsider. You might feel like you do not belong. Remember the firstborn. Remember Jesus. He makes you part of the family. You are a brother. You are a sister. You are included.


Faith Builder
Write down this truth: "I am part of God's family." Say it out loud. Thank Jesus for including you.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the firstborn. Thank you for making me part of the family. Thank you for including me. Help me to live as a son. Help me to live as a daughter. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 3: The Shadow of the Firstborn

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male a year old. You may take it from the sheep or from the goats." - Exodus 12:5 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The lamb had to be perfect. It had to be without blemish. It had to be without spot. It had to be sacrificed. The lamb was a shadow. The lamb was a preview. The lamb was a pattern. And the lamb points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, 'Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!'" - John 1:29


Jesus is the Lamb. He is the Lamb of God. He is perfect. He is without blemish. He is without spot. He was sacrificed. The lamb in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need a sacrifice. You might need a substitute. You might need someone to take your place. Remember the lamb. Remember Jesus. He is the Lamb of God. He takes away the sin of the world. He takes away your sin.


Faith Builder
Write down this truth: "Jesus is the Lamb of God." Say it out loud. Thank Him for taking away your sin.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the Lamb of God. Thank you for taking away the sin of the world. Thank you for taking away my sin. Help me to trust in your sacrifice. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 4: The Shadow of the Lamb

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"The blood will be a sign for you on the houses where you are, and when I see the blood, I will pass over you." - Exodus 12:13 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The blood was a sign. It was a protection. It was a covering. The blood was a shadow. The blood was a preview. The blood was a pattern. And the blood points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, in accordance with the riches of God's grace." - Ephesians 1:7


Jesus is the blood. He is the one who shed His blood. He is the one who provides redemption. He is the one who provides forgiveness. The blood in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need protection. You might need a covering. You might need redemption. Remember the blood. Remember Jesus. He shed His blood for you. He provides redemption for you. He provides forgiveness for you.


Faith Builder
Think of a sin you are struggling with. Write it down. Then write down this truth: "Jesus' blood covers my sin." Thank Him for His grace.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for your blood. Thank you for shedding your blood for me. Thank you for redemption. Thank you for forgiveness. Help me to live in your grace. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 5: The Shadow of the Blood

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"Then the LORD said to Moses, 'I will rain down bread from heaven for you. The people are to go out each day and gather enough for that day.'" - Exodus 16:4 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The bread was manna. It was from heaven. It was a provision. The bread was a shadow. The bread was a preview. The bread was a pattern. And the bread points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty." - John 6:35


Jesus is the bread. He is the bread of life. He is the provision. He is the one who satisfies. The bread in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might be hungry. You might be in a wilderness. You might need bread. Remember the bread. Remember Jesus. He is the bread of life. He satisfies your hunger. He fills your soul.


Faith Builder
Eat a piece of bread. As you eat it, thank Jesus for being the bread of life. Thank Him for satisfying your hunger.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the bread of life. Thank you for satisfying my hunger. Thank you for filling my soul. Help me to feed on your truth. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 6: The Shadow of the Bread

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. Strike the rock, and water will come out of it for the people to drink." - Exodus 17:6 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The water came from the rock. It was a miracle. It was a provision. The water was a shadow. The water was a preview. The water was a pattern. And the water points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"Whoever believes in me, as Scripture has said, rivers of living water will flow from within them." - John 7:38


Jesus is the water. He is the living water. He is the source of life. He is the one who quenches thirst. The water in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might be thirsty. You might be dry. You might need living water. Remember the water. Remember Jesus. He is the living water. He quenches your thirst. He refreshes your soul.


Faith Builder
Drink a glass of water. As you drink it, thank Jesus for being the living water. Thank Him for refreshing your soul.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the living water. Thank you for quenching my thirst. Thank you for refreshing my soul. Help me to drink from your river. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 7: The Shadow of the Water

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"He is the Rock, his works are perfect, and all his ways are just. A faithful God who does no wrong, upright and just is he." - Deuteronomy 32:4 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The rock was a symbol. It was a symbol of strength. It was a symbol of stability. The rock was a shadow. The rock was a preview. The rock was a pattern. And the rock points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"They all drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ." - 1 Corinthians 10:4


Jesus is the rock. He is the spiritual rock. He is the foundation. He is the cornerstone. The rock in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need a foundation. You might need stability. You might need strength. Remember the rock. Remember Jesus. He is the rock. He is the foundation. He is the cornerstone.


Faith Builder
Find a rock. Hold it in your hand. Feel its strength. Thank Jesus for being your rock. Thank Him for being your foundation.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the rock. Thank you for being the foundation. Thank you for being the cornerstone. Help me to build my life on you. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 8: The Shadow of the Rock

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"So Moses made a bronze snake and put it up on a pole. Then when anyone was bitten by a snake and looked at the bronze snake, they lived." - Numbers 21:9 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The serpent was lifted up. It was a symbol. It was a type. The serpent was a shadow. The serpent was a preview. The serpent was a pattern. And the serpent points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up, that everyone who believes may have eternal life in him." - John 3:14-15


Jesus is the serpent. He was lifted up. He was lifted up on a cross. He was lifted up for us. The serpent in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might be dying. You might be dying from sin. You might be dying from shame. Look at Jesus. He was lifted up for you. Look at Him and live.


Faith Builder
Draw a picture of a cross. Write the word "Look" next to it. Every time you look at it, remember to look at Jesus.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being lifted up for me. Thank you for being raised on a cross. Thank you for the promise that whoever looks at you will live. Help me to look at you. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 9: The Shadow of the Serpent

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"Hang the curtain from the clasps and place the ark of the covenant law behind the curtain. The curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place." - Exodus 26:33 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The veil was a barrier. It was a separation. The veil was a shadow. The veil was a preview. The veil was a pattern. And the veil points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom." - Matthew 27:51


Jesus is the veil. He is the barrier. He is the torn curtain. He is the fulfillment of the veil. The veil in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might feel separated from God. You might feel like there is a barrier. Remember the veil. Remember Jesus. He removed the barrier. He tore the curtain. He opened the way. You can come to God now.


Faith Builder
Draw a picture of a curtain. Then draw a line through it, tearing it in two. Write the word "Jesus" on the tear. Thank Him for opening the way to God.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for opening the way. Thank you for removing the barrier. Thank you for tearing the curtain. Help me to come to God. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 10: The Shadow of the Veil

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"The LORD said to Moses: 'Tell your brother Aaron that he is not to come whenever he chooses into the Most Holy Place behind the curtain in front of the atonement cover on the ark, or else he will die.'" - Leviticus 16:2 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The high priest was the mediator. He was the go-between. The high priest was a shadow. The high priest was a preview. The high priest was a pattern. And the high priest points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has ascended into heaven, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to the faith we profess." - Hebrews 4:14


Jesus is the high priest. He is the mediator. He is the go-between. He is the fulfillment of the high priest. The high priest in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need a mediator. You might need someone to represent you. You might need someone to intercede for you. Remember the high priest. Remember Jesus. He is your high priest. He represents you. He intercedes for you.


Faith Builder
Write down one thing you need Jesus to represent you in. Thank Him for being your high priest.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being my high priest. Thank you for representing me. Thank you for interceding for me. Help me to come to God. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 11: The Shadow of the High Priest

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"For the life of a creature is in the blood, and I have given it to you to make atonement for yourselves on the altar; it is the blood that makes atonement for one's life." - Leviticus 17:11 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The sacrifice was an offering. It was an atonement. The sacrifice was a shadow. The sacrifice was a preview. The sacrifice was a pattern. And the sacrifice points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God." - 1 Peter 3:18


Jesus is the sacrifice. He is the offering. He is the atonement. He is the fulfillment of the sacrifice. The sacrifice in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need a sacrifice. You might need an offering. You might need atonement. Remember the sacrifice. Remember Jesus. He is the sacrifice. He is the offering. He is the atonement.


Faith Builder
Think of a sin you are struggling with. Write it down. Thank Jesus for being the sacrifice for that sin.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the sacrifice. Thank you for being the offering. Thank you for being the atonement. Help me to trust in your sacrifice. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 12: The Shadow of the Sacrifice

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"The goat will carry on itself all their sins to a remote place; and the man shall release it in the wilderness." - Leviticus 16:22 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The scapegoat carried the sins. It carried them away. The scapegoat was a shadow. The scapegoat was a preview. The scapegoat was a pattern. And the scapegoat points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"We all, like sheep, have gone astray, each of us has turned to our own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all." - Isaiah 53:6


Jesus is the scapegoat. He carried our sins. He carried them away. He is the fulfillment of the scapegoat. The scapegoat in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need your sins carried away. You might need them removed. You might need them gone. Remember the scapegoat. Remember Jesus. He carried your sins away. He removed them. They are gone.


Faith Builder
Write a mistake on a piece of paper. Tie it to a balloon. Let the balloon go. Watch it float away. Thank Jesus for carrying your sins away.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for carrying my sins away. Thank you for removing them. Thank you for taking them to the cross. Help me to trust in your removal. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 13: The Shadow of the Scapegoat

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"Tell the Israelites to bring you a red heifer without defect or blemish and that has never been under a yoke." - Numbers 19:2 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The red heifer was a sacrifice. It was a cleansing. The red heifer was a shadow. The red heifer was a preview. The red heifer was a pattern. And the red heifer points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"The high priest carries the blood of animals into the Most Holy Place as a sin offering, but the bodies are burned outside the camp. And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate to make the people holy through his own blood." - Hebrews 13:11-12


Jesus is the red heifer. He suffered outside the city gate. He was burned. He was the cleansing. He is the fulfillment of the red heifer. The red heifer in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need cleansing. You might need purification. You might need to be made holy. Remember the red heifer. Remember Jesus. He cleanses you. He purifies you. He makes you holy.


Faith Builder
Wash your hands. As you wash them, thank Jesus for cleansing you. Thank Him for making you holy.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for cleansing me. Thank you for purifying me. Thank you for making me holy. Help me to trust in your cleansing. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 14: The Shadow of the Red Heifer

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"This is to be a lasting ordinance for you: On the tenth day of the seventh month you must deny yourselves and not do any work—whether native-born or a foreigner residing among you—because on this day atonement will be made for you, to cleanse you." - Leviticus 16:29-30 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The Day of Atonement was a day of cleansing. It was a day of forgiveness. The Day of Atonement was a shadow. The Day of Atonement was a preview. The Day of Atonement was a pattern. And the Day of Atonement points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"He did not enter by means of the blood of goats and calves; but he entered the Most Holy Place once for all by his own blood, thus obtaining eternal redemption." - Hebrews 9:12


Jesus is the Day of Atonement. He is the high priest. He is the sacrifice. He entered the Most Holy Place once for all. He obtained eternal redemption. The Day of Atonement in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need atonement. You might need cleansing. You might need forgiveness. Remember the Day of Atonement. Remember Jesus. He made atonement for you. He cleansed you. He forgave you.


Faith Builder
Write down this truth: "Jesus made atonement for me." Say it out loud. Thank Him for His atonement.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being my Day of Atonement. Thank you for making atonement for me. Thank you for cleansing me. Thank you for forgiving me. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 15: The Shadow of the Day of Atonement

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle." - Exodus 40:34 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The tabernacle was a dwelling. It was a tent. The tabernacle was a shadow. The tabernacle was a preview. The tabernacle was a pattern. And the tabernacle points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth." - John 1:14


Jesus is the tabernacle. He is the dwelling. He is the tent. He is the fulfillment of the tabernacle. The tabernacle in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might want to dwell with God. You might want to experience His presence. Remember the tabernacle. Remember Jesus. He is the dwelling. He is the presence. He came to dwell with you.


Faith Builder
Build a blanket fort. Crawl inside. Sit in the quiet. Thank Jesus for dwelling with you.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the tabernacle. Thank you for dwelling among us. Thank you for being with me. Help me to experience your presence. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 16: The Shadow of the Tabernacle

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"I have indeed built a magnificent temple for you, a place for you to dwell forever." - 1 Kings 8:13 (Written around 950 B.C.)


The temple was a building. It was a house. The temple was a shadow. The temple was a preview. The temple was a pattern. And the temple points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"Jesus answered them, 'Destroy this temple, and I will raise it again in three days.' But the temple he had spoken of was his body." - John 2:19-21


Jesus is the temple. He is the building. He is the house. He is the fulfillment of the temple. The temple in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need a place to meet God. You might need a place to worship. You might need a place to find peace. Remember the temple. Remember Jesus. He is the temple. He is the meeting place. He is the worship place.


Faith Builder
Find a quiet place. Sit down. Close your eyes. Imagine Jesus in the room with you. Thank Him for being the temple.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the temple. Thank you for being the meeting place. Thank you for being the worship place. Help me to meet with God. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 17: The Shadow of the Temple

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"Have Aaron your brother brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, so they may serve me as priests." - Exodus 28:1 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The priest was a mediator. He was an intercessor. The priest was a shadow. The priest was a preview. The priest was a pattern. And the priest points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"For there is one God and one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus." - 1 Timothy 2:5


Jesus is the priest. He is the mediator. He is the intercessor. He is the fulfillment of the priest. The priest in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need a mediator. You might need an intercessor. You might need someone to go between you and God. Remember the priest. Remember Jesus. He is the mediator. He is the intercessor.


Faith Builder
Pray a simple prayer. Thank Jesus for being your mediator. Thank Him for going between you and God.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being my priest. Thank you for being my mediator. Thank you for being my intercessor. Help me to come to God. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 18: The Shadow of the Priest

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"The LORD your God will raise up for you a king from among your fellow Israelites. You must listen to him." - Deuteronomy 17:15 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The king was a ruler. He was a leader. The king was a shadow. The king was a preview. The king was a pattern. And the king points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace." - Isaiah 9:6


Jesus is the king. He is the ruler. He is the leader. He is the fulfillment of the king. The king in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need a king. You might need a ruler. You might need a leader. Remember the king. Remember Jesus. He is the King of Kings. He rules you. He leads you.


Faith Builder
Make a paper crown. Put it on your head. Say, "I am a child of the King." Thank Jesus for being your King.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being my king. Thank you for ruling me. Thank you for leading me. Help me to follow you. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 19: The Shadow of the King

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)

The prophet was a messenger. He was a spokesman. The prophet was a shadow. The prophet was a preview. The prophet was a pattern. And the prophet points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"For Moses said, 'The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people; you must listen to everything he tells you.'" - Acts 3:22


Jesus is the prophet. He is the messenger. He is the spokesman. He is the fulfillment of the prophet. The prophet in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need a prophet. You might need a messenger. You might need a spokesman. Remember the prophet. Remember Jesus. He is the prophet. He speaks for God. He reveals God.


Faith Builder
Read a verse from the Bible. Ask Jesus to speak to you through it. Thank Him for being the prophet.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being my prophet. Thank you for speaking for God. Thank you for revealing God. Help me to listen to you. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 20: The Shadow of the Prophet

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"The LORD is my shepherd, I lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters." - Psalm 23:1-2 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


The shepherd was a guide. He was a protector. The shepherd was a shadow. The shepherd was a preview. The shepherd was a pattern. And the shepherd points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep." - John 10:11


Jesus is the shepherd. He is the guide. He is the protector. He is the fulfillment of the shepherd. The shepherd in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need a shepherd. You might need a guide. You might need a protector. Remember the shepherd. Remember Jesus. He is the good shepherd. He guides you. He protects you.


Faith Builder
Draw a picture of a shepherd with a sheep. Write the name "Jesus" above the shepherd. Thank Him for being your Good Shepherd.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being my shepherd. Thank you for guiding me. Thank you for protecting me. Help me to follow you. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 21: The Shadow of the Shepherd

pages.body:

"He is the Rock, his works are perfect, and all his ways are just. A faithful God who does no wrong, upright and just is he." - Deuteronomy 32:4 (Written around 1400 B.C.)

"They all drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ." - 1 Corinthians 10:4

Jesus, thank you for being the rock. Thank you for being the foundation. Thank you for being the cornerstone. Help me to build my life on you. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.

pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"Then the LORD said to Moses, 'I will rain down bread from heaven for you. The people are to go out each day and gather enough for that day.'" - Exodus 16:4 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The manna was bread from heaven. It was a provision. The manna was a shadow. The manna was a preview. The manna was a pattern. And the manna points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty." - John 6:35


Jesus is the manna. He is the bread of life. He is the provision. He is the fulfillment of the manna. The manna in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might be hungry. You might be in a wilderness. You might need bread. Remember the manna. Remember Jesus. He is the bread of life. He satisfies your hunger. He fills your soul.


Faith Builder
Eat a piece of bread. As you eat it, thank Jesus for being the bread of life. Thank Him for satisfying your hunger.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the bread of life. Thank you for satisfying my hunger. Thank you for filling my soul. Help me to feed on your truth. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 23: The Shadow of the Manna (Continued)

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. Strike the rock, and water will come out of it for the people to drink." - Exodus 17:6 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The water came from the rock. It was a miracle. It was a provision. The water was a shadow. The water was a preview. The water was a pattern. And the water points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"Whoever believes in me, as Scripture has said, rivers of living water will flow from within them." - John 7:38


Jesus is the water. He is the living water. He is the source of life. He is the one who quenches thirst. The water in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might be thirsty. You might be dry. You might need living water. Remember the water. Remember Jesus. He is the living water. He quenches your thirst. He refreshes your soul.


Faith Builder
Drink a glass of water. As you drink it, thank Jesus for being the living water. Thank Him for refreshing your soul.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the living water. Thank you for quenching my thirst. Thank you for refreshing my soul. Help me to drink from your river. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 24: The Shadow of the Water from the Rock

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"So Moses made a bronze snake and put it up on a pole. Then when anyone was bitten by a snake and looked at the bronze snake, they lived." - Numbers 21:9 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The bronze serpent was lifted up. It was a symbol. The bronze serpent was a shadow. The bronze serpent was a preview. The bronze serpent was a pattern. And the bronze serpent points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up, that everyone who believes may have eternal life in him." - John 3:14-15


Jesus is the bronze serpent. He was lifted up. He was lifted up on a cross. He was lifted up for us. The bronze serpent in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might be dying. You might be dying from sin. You might be dying from shame. Look at Jesus. He was lifted up for you. Look at Him and live.


Faith Builder
Draw a picture of a cross. Write the word "Look" next to it. Every time you look at it, remember to look at Jesus.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being lifted up for me. Thank you for being raised on a cross. Thank you for the promise that whoever looks at you will live. Help me to look at you. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 25: The Shadow of the Bronze Serpent

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'Select some towns to be your cities of refuge, to which a person who has killed someone accidentally may flee.'" - Numbers 35:10-11 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The cities of refuge were safe places. They were sanctuaries. The cities of refuge were shadows. They were previews. They were patterns. And they point to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus." - Romans 8:1


Jesus is the city of refuge. He is the safe place. He is the sanctuary. He is the fulfillment of the cities of refuge. The cities of refuge in the Old Testament are shadows. They are previews. They are patterns. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need a safe place. You might need a sanctuary. You might need protection. Remember the cities of refuge. Remember Jesus. He is your safe place. He is your sanctuary. He is your protection.


Faith Builder
Find a quiet, safe place in your home. Sit there for a few minutes. Thank Jesus for being your city of refuge.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being my city of refuge. Thank you for being my safe place. Thank you for being my sanctuary. Help me to run to you. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 26: The Shadow of the Cities of Refuge

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy. Six days you shall labor and do all your work, but the seventh day is a sabbath to the LORD your God." - Exodus 20:8-10 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The Sabbath was a day of rest. It was a day of peace. The Sabbath was a shadow. The Sabbath was a preview. The Sabbath was a pattern. And the Sabbath points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest." - Matthew 11:28


Jesus is the Sabbath. He is the rest. He is the peace. He is the fulfillment of the Sabbath. The Sabbath in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might be tired. You might be weary. You might be burdened. Remember the Sabbath. Remember Jesus. He is your rest. He is your peace. He is your refreshment.


Faith Builder
Take a nap. Read a book. Go for a walk. Do something restful. As you rest, thank Jesus for being your rest.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being my rest. Thank you for being my peace. Thank you for giving me rest. Help me to rest in you. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 27: The Shadow of the Sabbath

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"Consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you; each of you is to return to your family property and to your own clan." - Leviticus 25:10 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The Jubilee was a year of freedom. It was a year of release. The Jubilee was a shadow. The Jubilee was a preview. The Jubilee was a pattern. And the Jubilee points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to proclaim freedom for the prisoners and recovery of sight for the blind, to set the oppressed free, to proclaim the year of the Lord's favor." - Luke 4:18-19


Jesus is the Jubilee. He is the freedom. He is the release. He is the fulfillment of the Jubilee. The Jubilee in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need freedom. You might need release. You might need restoration. Remember the Jubilee. Remember Jesus. He is your freedom. He is your release. He is your restoration.


Faith Builder
Ring a bell. Shout "Freedom!" Thank Jesus for setting you free. Thank Him for being your Jubilee.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being my Jubilee. Thank you for proclaiming freedom to me. Thank you for releasing me. Thank you for restoring me. Help me to walk in your freedom. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 28: The Shadow of the Jubilee

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"I establish my covenant with you: Never again will all life be destroyed by the waters of a flood; never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth." - Genesis 9:11 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The covenant was an agreement. It was a promise. The covenant was a shadow. The covenant was a preview. The covenant was a pattern. And the covenant points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"In the same way, after the supper he took the cup, saying, 'This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.'" - Luke 22:20


Jesus is the covenant. He is the new covenant. He is the fulfillment of the covenant. The covenant in the Old Testament is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need a covenant. You might need an agreement. You might need a promise. Remember the covenant. Remember Jesus. He made a new covenant with you. He made a new agreement with you. He made a new promise with you.


Faith Builder
Write down one promise from the new covenant. Say it out loud. Thank Jesus for making a new covenant with you.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for the new covenant. Thank you for the new agreement. Thank you for the new promise. Help me to live in the new covenant. Help me to follow the reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 29: The Shadow of the Covenant

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Promise (OT)
"I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, and you will be a blessing. I will bless those who bless you, and whoever curses you I will curse; and all peoples on earth will be blessed through you." - Genesis 12:2-3 (Written around 2000 B.C.)


The promise to Abraham was a hope. It was a future. The promise was a shadow. The promise was a preview. The promise was a pattern. And the promise points to Jesus.


The Proof (NT)
"This is the genealogy of Jesus the Messiah the son of David, the son of Abraham..." - Matthew 1:1


Jesus is the fulfillment of the promise. He is the descendant of Abraham. He is the one who blesses the whole world. The promise to Abraham is a shadow. It is a preview. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


Why It Matters For Your New Life
You are new to the faith. You might need a promise. You might need a hope. You might need a future. Remember the promise. Remember Jesus. He is the fulfillment. He is the hope. He is the future. He is the blessing.


Faith Builder
Write down one thing you have learned about the Old Testament shadows over the last 30 days. Thank God for the shadows. Thank Him for Jesus, the reality.


The Prayer
God, thank you for the shadows. Thank you for the Old Testament. Thank you for the previews. Thank you for the patterns. Thank you for Jesus. Thank you for the reality. Help me to live in the reality. Help me to follow the real thing. Amen.



END MATTER


The 30-Day Shadow Challenge
You have journeyed through 30 Old Testament shadows. Now what? I challenge you to read the Gospel of John. It is 21 chapters. It will show you how Jesus is the fulfillment of every shadow. As you read, look for the shadows. Look for the patterns. Look for Jesus.


A Note on Faith
The shadows are evidence. They are evidence of a divine plan. But evidence does not save you. The shadows point to a person. The shadows point to Jesus. You can understand the shadows and still miss the reality. The invitation is for your heart. Jesus said, "Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in." The shadows are on the table. The door is open. It is your choice.


About the Author
Christine A. loves helping new believers build a strong foundation. He believes that faith is not a blind leap. It is a confident step based on evidence. He lives with his family and enjoys hiking and reading.


Coming Next: The Rescue Plan
If you enjoyed this journey, the next book in the series goes deeper. The Rescue Plan takes a 30 day look at learning how Old Testament heroes point to your freedom. It is for the new believer who wants to go further.

Scan the QR code below to get the next book in the series. Visit our website to download a free reading plan. Join our community of believers. The journey is not over. The adventure is just beginning.

A soft, warm cream or light parchment background. A large, glowing scroll sits in the center. On the scroll, a series of shadows is drawn in gray lines. The shadows are shaped like a lamb, a priest, a king, a shepherd, and a rock. They are all pointing to a bright, glowing cross in the center. The title OLD TESTAMENT SHADOWS is in a strong, trustworthy, bold serif font. The subtitle is in a gentle, welcoming sans-serif. The overall feel is warm, inviting, and full of hope.
